subject: Five-point go/no-go checklist and smoke coda for Northridge VPC cutover
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@northridge-hosting.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@acmepay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Five-point go/no-go checklist and smoke coda for Northridge VPC cutover

Team / Jenna —

Per our readiness call earlier this week, attaching the compact five-point go/no-go checklist I want us to run through at T-30 and again at the start of the maintenance window. The aim is to keep the decision tight and unambiguous: if any item is red, we pause and execute the rollback lanes in the runbook.

Key asks in this note:
- Karthik: confirm KV cache warmup schedule and whether the CSV you shared needs to change for the morning peak.
- Rishi: confirm the exact telemetry markers (trace IDs and dashboards) we'll sample for the 15-minute smoke.
- Neha: prep two on-call rotations (primary + backup) and post-cutover cadence.
- Jenna: confirm Northridge will keep the BGP session window open for 60 minutes after traffic shift.

Attachments: 20261113-laura-5point-checklist.pdf (PDF, 34KB); kv-warmup-schedule.csv (CSV, 3KB).

If all green, we'll do T-0: 09:30 PST start; smoke window 09:45–10:00; full ramp 10:00–11:30. Please reply with explicit "GO" or name the red item.

Thanks —

Laura Bennett
Senior Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@northridge-hosting.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@acmepay.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Five-point go/no-go checklist and smoke coda for Northridge VPC cutover

Laura —

Thanks, received. Northridge confirms BGP hold-open request approved; we will keep the session stable for +60m post shift. Our network ops lead (Tom) will be on the bridge at T-10.

Two quick notes:
1) We have one change scheduled in our backbone at 08:00 UTC but it is low-risk; no impact expected. If you want I can provide an emergency rollback contact in the bridge.
2) We'll provide a short post-shift summary (reachability + routing table diff) within 10 minutes of completion.

GO from Northridge side pending your green checks.

—Jenna
Northridge Hosting — Platform Partnerships

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jenna Park <jenna.park@northridge-hosting.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Five-point go/no-go checklist and smoke coda for Northridge VPC cutover

Laura / team —

Checked KV warmup plan. Attached CSV is the final schedule I am pushing: warmup shard order is unchanged, but I've shifted the priming to start at 09:10 PST to avoid overlap with an internal job. The plan still hits the same total token count and preserves parallelism.

Also, note two operational caveats:
- If KV warmup step 3 fails to reach 95% hit-rate within 10 minutes, we auto-hold and roll the priming back to step 2 (runbook section 4.2).
- We need a short port ACL tweak on Northridge side to allow 10.20.0.0/22 for the diagnostics probes (Jenna — please confirm ACLs allow this).

Attachments: kv-warmup-schedule.csv (updated, 3KB).

Karthik
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer — Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Five-point go/no-go checklist and smoke coda for Northridge VPC cutover

Quick ops add —

From the runbook perspective, two short mitigations we should call out explicitly on the bridge:
1) Fallback model routing: if latency > 250ms p95 for 2 consecutive 5-minute windows, we switch traffic to the smaller quantized variant in the same region and hold for 20 minutes (see runbook step 6).
2) Observability stub: Rishi, please make sure the trace filter includes the header "X-NH-Session" that Northridge will inject; that'll let us correlate their routing diffs with our request traces.

I'll stay on the bridge through T+90 to help with the rollback if needed.

—Aditya
Principal Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: RE: Five-point go/no-go checklist and smoke coda for Northridge VPC cutover

All —

Telemetry prep complete and smoke runbook is live at: https://dash.redwood.inference/boards/Northridge-GoLive-smoke?snapshot=20261113

Sampling markers: we will watch the following during the 09:45–10:00 smoke window:
- p50/p95/p99 latency shards for the primary model route
- KV hit-rate per shard (threshold > 95%)
- Error ratio (5xx) <= 0.5% over the window
- Trace correlation for header X-NH-Session (Aditya referenced)

I ran a drypull of the traces and the sample dashboard shows expected telemetry buckets. I also uploaded a short file with the telemetry endpoints: telemetry-sample-urls.txt (attached).

GO from infra/telemetry side assuming Northridge confirms ACLs.

Rishi Malhotra
Staff Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

- KV warmup: Karthik moved priming start to 09:10; watch step 3 for auto-hold.
- Telemetry: Rishi dashboard live and sample URLs attached.
- Ops coverage: Neha has two rotations staffed; Aditya + Karthik on bridge.
